name: Hotel Fairmont Palliser
insider_take: This grand railway hotel has been Calgary's crown jewel since 1914, standing as a testament to the city's frontier spirit and modern sophistication.
whats_special: Built during the golden age of railway travel, the Fairmont Palliser is one of Canada's original grand railway hotels. Its stunning sandstone facade overlooks the historic Stephen Avenue, and the hotel has hosted royalty, celebrities, and world leaders for over a century. The property features original terrazzo floors and ornate plasterwork that have been meticulously preserved.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing south for spectacular views of the Canadian Rockies on clear days – the mountains appear to rise dramatically from the prairie horizon.
dont_miss: The famous Rimrock Bar, which has been a Calgary institution since 1950, and the hotel's location puts you steps from the +15 Skywalk system – the world's most extensive network of enclosed pedestrian bridges connecting downtown Calgary.
pros: Historic luxury landmark with grand architecture and timeless elegance
Prime downtown Calgary location within walking distance of major attractions
Exceptional service standards and renowned Fairmont hospitality
Elegant rooms and suites with classic furnishings and modern amenities
cons: Heritage building may have smaller room sizes compared to modern hotels
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and downtown location
